label: Tutorial: Workflow detail
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Workflow detail page (endpoint task_scheduler.admin_panel_workflow). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing). A step whose target is not on the screen is skipped.

steps.title: A workflow
steps.text: Its title, description and where you are. **Back to workflows** returns to the list.

steps.title: Run, pause, share
steps.text:
**Run** launches it now (a preview shows what will run). **Stop** stops a launch in progress.

The **Active / Paused** button: a paused workflow launches nothing on its own. **Share**: a read-only link to its history and notebook. **⋯**: edit, duplicate, export, save as a template, delete (you go back to the list).

steps.title: History and Tasks
steps.text:
**History**: every launch, how it ended, how long it took, and the next ones planned.

**Tasks**: the pipeline — what runs first, what runs after what (on success, failure or always), live progress and the logs of each task. Switch to the **canvas** to build it: add tasks, link them, set their trigger, retries, timeout and alerts.

steps.title: Launches
steps.text: Click a launch to see its path in the Tasks tab: which tasks ran, were skipped or failed, and their logs. Sort by any column; tick launches to delete their history.

steps.title: Notebook
steps.text: Markdown notes and files about this workflow — why it exists, how to fix it when it fails, a note on one launch. Pinned notes show at the top of the page.
